commands.text: The pit holds sacks, broken tools and a shoe with the foot still inside it. Nothing here has a proper place.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: No one dumps another load here.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Markers first. We do not enter until the ground and the dead are safe to approach.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I said the shortage would pass if we kept the carts running.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: The carts kept running. The shortage became people.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: There are two kinds of marks on these tools. We may have more than one crew to account for.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I will name both. Even the ones who left.
